subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Product Life Extension
description: A 60-second lesson on Product Life Extension.

hook.text: Patagonia repairs 100,000 garments a year instead of selling new ones. They make less but build more loyalty.

buildup.text: Product life extension keeps goods in use longer through repair, refurbishment, and maintenance services.

discovery.text: Every year a product stays in use is a year without new resource extraction, manufacturing, and shipping.

twist.text: Planned obsolescence is the enemy. Some products are designed to break so you'll buy again.

climax.text: Right-to-repair laws in the EU now require manufacturers to make spare parts available for years.

punchline.text: The greenest product is the one you already own.

quiz.question: What is product life extension?
options: Keeping goods in use longer through repair and maintenance
